title: T-Mobile’s path to IPv6 Only
summary: A Rocky Mountain IPv6 Taskforce talk in which T-Mobile's Stephan Lagerholm explains how the carrier went IPv6-only using DNS64 and 464XLAT, with a live Android demo and best practices.
why: It is the standard citation in IPv6 threads that large mobile carriers already run phones with only IPv6 addresses.

quote.text: Here's a dude from T-Mobile explaining how they have (in 2017) over ten million end-customer devices without any IPv4 addresses assigned
